ONE KNOB: recon_eta 30.0 -> 5.0 (DPS soft-guidance gain DOWN). All else IDENTICAL to iter-1 (n_steps=25, init=fbp, recon_dcstep_every=0 so the hard-CG projection stays OFF -> pure soft DPS; recon_eta_clamp=false). iter-1 NUMBERS (eta=30): SSIM 0.3688, hr=0.0, PSNR 10.55, RMSE 0.01485, 868.65 s / 214 slices = 4.06 s/slice -- FAR BELOW the LD-FBP floor 0.8078 AND below its own FBP init, and below the constrained sibling's 0.3937. FAILURE MODE (shared with the constrained sibling's iter-2 diagnosis): eta is a dimensionless gain in the adaptively-normalized DPS step (step = (eta/||resid||)*grad, Chung 2023 eq.12); the literature/demo/breast default is 1.0, so eta=30 (a leftover discarded-614 boundary-metric hint) is a ~30x overshoot that, with recon_eta_clamp=false (no per-step displacement cap), blows the FBP-initialized iterate OFF-MANIFOLD every reverse step -> the recon is corrupted, not merely prior-dominated drift. DISTINCT FROM THE CONSTRAINED SIBLING (which is running eta 30->1.0 WITH hard-CG every=5): this unconstrained variant has recon_dcstep_every=0, i.e. NO hard-CG fidelity backstop, so the soft DPS gradient is its ONLY data-consistency mechanism -> it needs MORE guidance than the constrained sibling. I pick eta=5.0 (a clearly different magnitude than the sibling's 1.0) so the pair BRACKETS the soft-guidance response: constrained = gentle-soft (eta=1) + hard-CG; unconstrained = moderate-soft (eta=5) + no-CG. BUDGET: eta is a free scalar multiplier on the existing per-step gradient -- no extra forward/backward or projection calls -> per-slice cost stays ~4.06 s; 214 slices * 4.06 s = 869 s = 14.5 min < 20-min (1200 s) wall (~330 s headroom); n_steps unchanged so no budget risk. val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default). HYPOTHESIS: if I lower eta 30 -> 5, SSIM rises above the iter-1 0.3688 because the gentler-but-still-substantial soft DPS gradient keeps the FBP-initialized iterate on-manifold while still pulling toward the measurements (less off-manifold corruption). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays ~0.37-0.5 (still << the 0.8078 LD-FBP floor) at eta=5 -- and the constrained sibling likewise fails to clear FBP at eta=1 -- then the DPS step size was NOT the issue: the Mayo v4 DDPM prior is mismatched to the rebinned-Mayo distribution under the 25-step low-T budget (mirrors the breast-DDPM hr=0 structural verdict: globally faithful but not conditionally faithful under DPS). iter-3 would then redirect to n_steps (longer DDIM trajectory) or accept an architectural prior-mismatch ceiling, not the guidance gain.
